items.title: VPN timeout on hotel wifi
items.body: TICKET-123 is waiting on the network team. Workaround: split tunnel off, then reconnect. Updated 2026-09-12.

items.title: Laptop stipend exception
items.body: TICKET-456 was approved for $1,800 on 2026-08-02. Receipts go to finance@example.com.

items.title: PTO policy
items.body: Full-time staff accrue 20 PTO days per year. Requests over 5 consecutive days need a manager note. Unused days up to 5 roll over.

items.title: VPN access policy
items.body: VPN is required off the office network. Personal devices are not approved. Access reviews happen every 90 days.

items.title: Expense policy
items.body: Meals under $75 do not need a receipt. Client meals over $150 need a director. Submit within 30 days.

items.title: Incident reporting
items.body: Report suspected account compromise to security@example.com within 1 hour. Do not reset the password yourself if the mailbox is forwarding.

items.title: Work from anywhere
items.body: Up to 20 work-from-anywhere days per calendar year. Not valid in a country where the company has no entity.

items.title: On-call policy
items.body: Primary on-call responds within 15 minutes. Handoff notes are required. Comp day is 1 day per weekend shift.

items.title: Travel policy
items.body: Book economy for flights under 6 hours. Hotels capped at $250 per night in the US. Book 14 days ahead when you can.

items.title: SSO outage follow-up
items.body: TICKET-789 closed on 2026-07-19. Root cause was an expired signing cert. Customers saw errors for 42 minutes.
